note.text: The industry treated more data as an inexhaustible fuel source, but the useful text on the internet is finite and mostly already consumed. The next leap won't come from scraping harder; it will come from systems that learn the way a careful reader does, extracting more insight per page rather than more pages per hour. Organizations betting their AI roadmap on endless scale should ask what happens when the easy gains run out and quality of reasoning becomes the only lever left.}
